title: Duplicate 'Step b' comment label in ReceiptHandler
description: lib.rs ReceiptHandler has two consecutive comments labeled 'Step b:' — one for 'parse remaining args' and one for 'validate kind'. They are 6 lines apart. A reader following the step labels to understand the flow hits two 'Step b' entries and loses confidence in the numbering for all subsequent steps. Fix: rename the second 'Step b' to 'Step c' and renumber all following steps accordingly.
